verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes blog guides that appear to be openly accessible. One maps the 10 EB-1 criteria to engineering careers, covering what wins and what doesn't. Another explains startup H-1B sponsorship eligibility, cost, timeline and startup-specific pitfalls. The evidence shows only two such posts and gives no detail on their depth, and the eligibility checker is a lead-capture style intake rather than a free guide. missing for 10: evidence of a substantial guide library covering founder visas such as O-1 and startup paths, concrete real case examples, explicit confirmation that content is ungated, and independent corroboration of guide depth.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait

citations.quote: the 10 USCIS EB-1 criteria mapped to actual engineering careers, with what wins, what doesn't, and how to build the record.
